hero.title: Plan your visit
hero.lede: Here’s what a first Sunday at Lafayette looks like, so you can walk in knowing what to expect. Come as you are — you’re welcome exactly as you are.

expect.title: What to expect on a Sunday

cards.title: A friendly face at the door
cards.body: Someone will be near the door to help you find your way and answer any questions. You don’t need to know anyone or do anything ahead of time.

cards.title: Where to park
cards.body: [Office to write: where to park, the best door to use, and accessible parking.]

cards.title: Come as you are
cards.body: There’s no dress code. Wear whatever you’re comfortable in.

cards.title: How long it runs
cards.body: Bible classes for all ages start at 9 AM. Worship starts at 10 AM and runs about [X minutes — Kyle to confirm]. Come to one or both.

cards.title: Classes for every age
cards.body: At 9 AM there are Bible classes for children, students and adults. [Kyle to write: what’s available for kids during worship, and how drop-off works.]

cards.title: What worship is like
cards.body: [Kyle to write: 2–3 plain sentences on singing, prayer, Scripture, the message and communion (the Lord’s Supper).]

items.title: Wednesdays at 7 PM
items.body: Bible study — a midweek time to study Scripture together.

form.title: Let us know you’re coming
form.intro: This is optional. If you tell us when you’re planning to visit, we’ll watch for you and help you find your way.
form.meetTitle: Kyle would be glad to meet you before you visit.
form.meetBody: Kyle is our minister. If you’d like to talk before your first Sunday, just ask.
form.privacy: We’ll only use this to welcome you. No mailing lists.
form.successBody: See you {date} at 10 AM, or at 9 AM for Bible classes. Someone from the church may email you before then to say hello.
